root_cause_description: Adversarial case ADV-020 (Logistics): Trap scenario - plausible narrative (market conditions, growth metrics) masks underlying issue (cohort deterioration, segment concentration, unit economics hidden in aggregated metrics). Must diagnose root cause before strategic action.
first_priority_action: Commission thorough diagnostic (cohort analysis, segment profitability, competitive positioning) to test plausible narrative against actual drivers before major strategic decisions.

root_cause_accuracy.rubric_10: Recognizes trap; recommends diagnosis before accepting narrative

rationale: Identify root cause and improvement opportunities
evidence_basis: Financial and operational data support diagnosis
